{{Quote|I've spoken ''[&hellip;]'' with Kardavan penitents who had spent their entire lives attempting to ameliorate the suffering of beings with whom they shared no bond of kinship or community.|Hali Ke's internal memorandum|<ref name="Author's Cut" />}}
The '''Kardavan penitents''' were a group<ref name="Author's Cut" /> that originated in<ref name="Planetnamia" /> the [[Kardava system/Legends|Kardava system]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim's]] [[Sevastol sector/Legends|Sevastol sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The group's membership included [[Human/Legends|Humans]]. Several penitents devoted their entire lives to alleviating the suffering experienced by individuals who were complete strangers to them. At some point by [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]],<ref name="Author's Cut" /> the [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoan]]<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|205|Ke, Hali}}</ref> [[Geneticist/Legends|geneticist]] [[Hali Ke]] interviewed and psychoanalized those penitents in an attempt to understand the various Human [[Brain/Legends|mental]] processes giving rise to viciousness as well as kindness and altruism that emerged from the properties of their [[Gene/Legends|genetic]] code. Ke later noted their encounter with the Kardavan penitents in an internal memorandum composed that [[Standard year/Legends|year]].<ref name="Author's Cut" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Kardavan penitents were originally meant to be introduced in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]]; however, the section that would have mentioned the group was cut before the book's release. The information regarding the penitents was later released in [[2014]] as part of [[Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|''Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare'' Author's Cut]], a series of articles published on the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars Blog|Blog]] by Fry and<ref name="Author's Cut" /> [[Del Rey]] editor<ref name="Celestials">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-the-celestials|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare'' Author's Cut &mdash; The Celestials|int=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut}}</ref> [[Erich Schoeneweiss]] containing various cut content from the book.<ref name="Author's Cut" />
